quote: We are the only animal species in which the female depends on the male for food, the only animal species in which the sex-relation is also an economic relation.
source: Charlotte Perkins Gilman, Women and Economics, chapter I (Small, Maynard and Company, 1898)

evidence.where: The University of Pennsylvania Digital Library transcription of the 1898 Small, Maynard first edition, and the Project Gutenberg text of the 1900 Putnam printing; both read identically.
evidence.locator: Chapter I, following the sentence beginning In view of these facts

reason: The sentence is in Chapter I, where Gilman first states the thesis the book is known by, and the wording and the hyphen in sex-relation are as printed. Two independent transcriptions agree.
